acceptance_criteria: OWASP ASVS Level 2 baseline implemented: ASVS checklist documented in docs/security/asvs-checklist.md; Level 3 applied for compliance-svc and credit-svc paths.
SAST: Semgrep rules and GitHub CodeQL configured and running on every PR; zero high/critical findings allowed to merge.
DAST: OWASP ZAP scheduled scan against staging environment; weekly run; results published to security dashboard.
SCA: Snyk and Dependabot configured for all repos; high/critical CVEs block merge after 7-day grace period.
Secret scanning: GitGuardian configured for all repos; GitHub native secret scanning enabled; push protection on for all repos prevents secrets from being committed.
Penetration testing: annual third-party pentest contracted; findings tracked in GitHub Security Advisories; retested within 90 days.
Bug bounty: HackerOne or Bugcrowd program configured and launched in Phase 3; scope document published.

metadata.description: Mock data for dashboard development and testing (SAST/DAST/SCA results)

principles: Security-first: All UI components must clearly communicate security status and actions
Consistent: Use standardized patterns for security alerts, status indicators, and configuration forms
Accessible: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for all security-related interfaces

recent_findings.message: Potentially unsafe use of dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Sanitize user input before rendering.
recent_findings.remediation: Use a sanitization library like DOMPurify or prefer React's built-in escaping.

recent_findings.message: SQL query constructed with string concatenation. Use parameterized queries.
recent_findings.remediation: Replace string interpolation with parameterized query or ORM.

recent_findings.message: Hardcoded API key detected. Move to environment variables or secret manager.
recent_findings.remediation: Remove hardcoded value and reference from environment or vault.

recent_findings.message: X-Frame-Options header is missing, making the application vulnerable to clickjacking attacks.
recent_findings.remediation: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN header to all responses.

recent_findings.message: Content-Security-Policy header is not set, increasing risk of XSS attacks.
recent_findings.remediation: Implement a strict CSP header allowing only trusted sources.

recent_findings.rule: Server Leaks Version Information via Server Header
recent_findings.message: Server header reveals nginx/1.22.0. Remove or obfuscate version information.
recent_findings.remediation: Set server_tokens off in nginx configuration.

recent_findings.message: Session cookie missing Secure flag. Cookie can be transmitted over unencrypted HTTP.
recent_findings.remediation: Set Secure and HttpOnly flags on all session cookies.

recent_findings.message: HSTS header not present. Users could be downgraded to HTTP.
recent_findings.remediation: Add Strict-Transport-Security header with a max-age of at least 31536000.

recent_findings.message: Prototype pollution in lodash versions < 4.17.21. Remote code execution possible.
recent_findings.remediation: Upgrade lodash to version 4.17.21 or later.

recent_findings.message: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in axios versions < 0.21.2.
recent_findings.remediation: Upgrade axios to version 0.21.2 or later.

recent_findings.message: Open redirect in qs library used by express. Versions < 4.17.3 affected.
recent_findings.remediation: Upgrade express to version 4.17.3 or later.

recent_findings.message: Potential AWS Access Key ID detected in example config file. Remove before committing.
recent_findings.remediation: Removed the example key and replaced with placeholder text.

recent_findings.message: Example GitHub token found in documentation. Use placeholder tokens only.
Private key detected in test fixtures. Use generated test keys only.
recent_findings.remediation: Replace with a non-sensitive test key or remove the file.

recent_findings.title: IDOR in Credit Application API
recent_findings.message: Authenticated users can access other users' credit applications by modifying the ID parameter.
recent_findings.remediation: Implemented proper authorization checks. Retest confirmed fix.

recent_findings.title: Mass Assignment in User Profile Update
recent_findings.message: User can escalate privileges by sending unexpected fields like 'role' or 'is_admin'.
recent_findings.remediation: Implement strict whitelist of allowed fields for profile updates.
